g.text: Fully aligned ergonomics with Sofle keyboard • Maintained all symbols and navigation
QWERTY • Home Row Modifiers (A=none, S=Alt, D=Ctrl, F=Cmd) • Left Thumb Space/Lower • Right Thumb Enter/Raise
Left Hand: ESDF Navigation Arrows & Media • Right Hand: Dedicated 10-Key Numpad block
Right Hand: Mirrored Brackets {{}} () [] • Left Hand: Math & Code Symbols ( - on X, _ on H, = on Z, + on C )
4. TRI LAYER (Hold Both Left & Right Thumbs)
F1-F12 Function Keys • Bluetooth Profiles & Clear • System & Studio Controls
Windows Layer: Toggle via Tri-layer WinTog key to switch Left Home Row to S=Alt, D=Win, F=Ctrl.
